[{'position': 1, 'item': {'name': "Apple MacBook Air M1 2020 13'' 8-Core CPU 7-Core GPU 256GB SSD Gray 8GB Ram", 'url': 'https://www.ebay.com/p/9055828714', 'image': 'https://i.ebayimg.com/thumbs/images/g/vtYAAOSwA3tnk8aQ/s-l400.webp', 'review': {'author': {'name': 'jlong678', '@type': 'Person'}, 'datePublished': '2023-12-26T13:31:16.000+00:00', 'reviewBody': 'Overall, the MacBook is worth getting. Its lifespan along makes it a great value. But it has flaws that Apple should’ve easily ironed out before releasing it. There are too many steps with the top tool bar to do simple actions, like closing a page. Symbols for various actions would be confusing for a first time user. [{'position': 1, 'item': {'name': "Apple MacBook Air M1 2020 13'' 8-Core CPU 7-Core GPU 256GB SSD Gray 8GB Ram", 'url': 'https://www.ebay.com/p/9055828714', 'image': 'https://i.ebayimg.com/thumbs/images/g/vtYAAOSwA3tnk8aQ/s-l400.webp', 'review': {'author': {'name': 'jlong678', '@type': 'Person'}, 'datePublished': '2023-12-26T13:31:16.000+00:00', 'reviewBody': 'Overall, the MacBook is worth getting. Its lifespan along makes it a great value. But it has flaws that Apple should’ve easily ironed out before releasing it. There are too many steps with the top tool bar to do simple actions, like closing a page. Symbols for various actions would be confusing for a first time user.
